column1: # Shared filter parity table (see SPEC.md section 6).
# Columns (TAB-separated): include_patterns  exclude_patterns  path  is_dir  expected_keep  [mode]
# Multiple patterns in a field are separated by '|'. Empty field = no patterns.
# mode is optional: absent/empty = gitignore-style patterns (6.1), "names" =
# trailing ** matches contents but not the dir itself
# ---- names mode (6.4): literal top-level entry names ----
# an included dir name covers its whole subtree, dir entries included
# a name matches files and dirs alike
# names are top-level only: no matching at depth
# an excluded dir name removes the whole subtree, but only at the top level
# a leading and/or trailing slash is accepted as the same name
# shell globs apply, but only against the top-level name
# a glob that matches a directory still covers its whole subtree
# a leading ! is literal here, not negation
